Name: Ridgeside Village - NPC Adventures Addon
Author: Rafseazz
Description:
[size=3][center]An add-on mod for Ridgeside Village. (Requires main mod to work!)[/center]One of the primary features of this addon is the lore expansion through over a hundred dialogues given to each recruitable NPC. Interacting with them in specific places will give you a peek with more lore through the eyes of your companion. We hope you enjoy it!
[center]- Rafseazz and mamaesh (RSV Creators)[/center][/size]
[center][color=red]NPC Adventures is not compatible with multiplayer or Android.[/color][/center]

After unlocking the ability to recruit companions in NPC Adventures, 28 different Ridgeside villagers can be recruited.
(Tip: To avoid having to go through the initial hoops to unlock this ability, enter the command [font=Courier New]debug seenmail na_invitation[/font]  into your SMAPI console.)

[u]Companion Details[/u][/size]

[b]Freelancers[/b]
[spoiler]
Freelancers are NPCs who can be hired to accompany you on your adventures. They boast higher skill levels than the average companion in their respective areas. Bryle and Ian can be hired at any time, whereas Daia and Jio will reject your offer if your combat level is 5 or lower. For all four, after reaching 8 hearts and seeing their 8 heart event, their prices will decrease by 50%, and if married, they will always be free to hire.

[b]Bryle[/b]
[list]
[*]Fights enemies
[*]Occasionally shields farmer from damage
[*]Grants +2 Attack +3 Defense
[*]Normal rate: 500g
[/list]
[b]Daia[/b]

[*]Increases friendship gained from interacting with other NPCs
